title: Share links, domains and agents without the dashboard
items: Connected agents can be listed and disconnected with an API key or a connected agent
Share links to requests can be listed and revoked with a key, and an agent can ask for a new one: it is published only once you approve it
Custom inbound domains can be listed, added, checked and routed with a key; removing one is an approval, since its mail is refused from then on
An agent can ask to rename the account, and you approve it
These approvals take effect the moment you approve, and the page says so
whk agents, whk share-links, whk domains and whk account rename; client.agents, client.shareLinks, client.domains and client.account in the TypeScript SDK; eleven new MCP tools
